notes: Windows Option-A run 172 passed artifact acquisition, SHA-256, Authenticode, installation, browser launch, semantic Playwright E2E, native Windows E2E, runtime component integration suite, and agent overlay integrity.
Agent CI run 85 passed typecheck, build, runtime tests, and SBOM generation after the MCP and vault fixes.
MCP includes an external child-process stdio roundtrip test; full external third-party MCP-client interoperability remains outside the initial release gate.
PDF merge/split is implemented and tested. OCR is optional for the initial release and remains a post-release provider capability.
Communications provider delivery remains an optional integration; the core approval-bound communication framework is tested.
Windows credential storage uses the Windows DPAPI Protect API and persists only protected blobs locally; plaintext is never returned to model-visible state or evidence.
Production signing and final release notices/package publication remain environment-dependent final gates.
Developer preview packaging is test-only and must not be treated as a production installer.
DEVOS_TEST_MODE is restricted to synthetic localhost fixtures and never disables production policy or arbitrary native execution.
